description: Fixes CAN-2001-1411 a format string vulnerability in the gm4 utility. No set uid root programs relied on gm4 and this fix is a preventive measure against a possible future exploit.
Fixes CAN-2001-1412 where the nidump utility provides access to the crypted passwords used to authenticate logins.
Fixes CVE-2001-0653, where an input validation error exists in Sendmail's debugging functionality which could lead to a system compromise.
Fixes CVE-2001-1022 where the groff component pic contained a format-string vulnerability.
